Any severance payment shall be made in accordance with applicable law and the payment terms set out in Schedule A. 4. NON-COMPETE. For twelve months after the Executive’s departure, the Executive shall not engage in competitive activities only to the extent, and within the scope and geographic area, permitted by applicable law. This restriction shall not prohibit the Executive from holding up to two percent of the outstanding securities of a publicly traded company as a passive investment.
